name: Keel Payroll
description: Payroll agent for a small business. The owner says who to pay and in which country. Keel quotes USD₮ into that country's stablecoin on Textile FX, pays the allowlisted wallet from a capped session, and returns a receipt. Replace this hosted file's endpoints with the public URL before calling register, or use scripts/register-8004.ts which builds a data: URI.
